no-restricted-syntax.message: REQ-020: Placeholder strings are prohibited in production code.
REQ-020: 'not implemented' markers are prohibited. Implement fully or remove.
REQ-020: 'coming soon' markers are prohibited in production code.
REQ-020: Dummy data is prohibited. Use real data sources.
REQ-020: throw 'not implemented' is a hard failure. Implement the function.
REQ-020: Mock data in production paths is prohibited. Use real data sources.
REQ-020: Stub implementations are prohibited. Implement fully or remove.
REQ-020: Fake data/responses are prohibited in production code.
REQ-020: Empty object returns may indicate missing implementation. Verify this is intentional.
REQ-021: Lorem ipsum text is prohibited in production code.
REQ-021: Sample data references are prohibited in production paths.
REQ-021: Simulated data/behavior is prohibited in production code.
REQ-021: Deferred-as-done — throwing 'later/phase/sprint' is a hard failure.
REQ-021: No-op functions are prohibited in production code.
REQ-021: Hardcoded value markers detected — use proper configuration or data sources.
REQ-021: Empty function body detected — implement fully or remove.
REQ-021: Empty arrow function body detected — implement fully or remove.
REQ-021: Empty catch block — errors must be handled, not swallowed.
